name: Redding (United States)
description: Light blue field with an orange hill at the hoist and a white road curving over it to the top edge, a stylised view of the Sundial Bridge and Shasta landscape.
history: Redding is a city in and the county seat of Shasta County, California, and the economic and cultural capital of the Shasta Cascade region of Northern California. The flag was adopted in 2017 (adopted after a redesign contest, according to English Wikipedia).
